menu_options.browser: Sign in with browser (local network beta)
Sign in with browser (local network beta)

session.title: Connect using a browser session
session.description: Sign in on the supplier website and paste the session JSON described in the README. Never publish these tokens.

browser.title: Sign in through your browser
browser.description: Home Assistant normally detects its local address automatically. Enter its private IPv4 address here only if detection failed, or advanced setup is enabled. Use your home network. The temporary HTTPS login window uses port 8743 and a self-signed certificate; accept the warning for this local address only. The integration saves a renewable session, never your password. Do not expose this port to the internet.

data.local_host: Home Assistant private LAN IPv4 address

browser_wait.title: Complete supplier sign-in
browser_wait.description: Open the website and sign in normally. This expires after 15 minutes. Setup finishes automatically. CAPTCHA is handled by the supplier website; no challenge is bypassed. The sign-in page opens separately and tries to close after success; if blocked, close that tab yourself.

error.invalid_session: Paste valid session JSON containing accessToken, refreshToken and anonymousId.
error.invalid_auth: Session expired or rejected. Sign in again and copy a fresh session.
error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve account data. Try later.
error.rate_limited: The supplier is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.login_cooldown: Please wait: at least 60 seconds between attempts and at most three attempts per 15 minutes.
error.browser_verification_required: The supplier requested browser verification. Choose Sign in with browser, or use the browser-session fallback.
error.otp_required: The supplier requested an OTP. OTP entry is not supported in this beta; use browser session setup.
error.browser_running: A browser sign-in is already active. Finish it or wait for its 15-minute expiry.
error.browser_cannot_start: Could not start HTTPS browser sign-in. Check the private LAN IPv4 address and whether port 8743 is already in use.

abort.wrong_account: The session belongs to a different set of accounts. Add it as a separate integration.
abort.browser_expired: Browser sign-in expired. Start a fresh flow.

init.title: Update frequency
init.description: 168 hours is weekly; 720 hours is every 30 days. Manual refresh remains available.

submit_gas_meter_reading.name: Submit gas meter reading
submit_gas_meter_reading.description: Preview by default. Real submission requires Dry run off and explicit confirmation. No automatic write retries. Administrator access required.

entity_id.name: Gas meter reading sensor
entity_id.description: Select Last actual gas meter reading for the correct gas account.

reading.name: Physical meter reading
reading.description: Whole meter digits only; ignore decimal digits. Do not enter billed kWh.

dry_run.name: Dry run (preview only)
dry_run.description: Validate and return a preview without sending a meter reading.

confirm.name: Confirm submission to supplier
confirm.description: Enable only when Dry run is off and you intend to send a real reading.
